name: Jean Houston
reason: Died on 16 May 2026 in Ashland, Oregon, aged 89 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jean_Houston, citing The New York Times obituary of 18 June 2026). Evolving Wisdom still sells her two recorded courses, but she no longer teaches, and her own site (jeanhouston.com) hasn't been updated since a 2020 message. Not on Spiritpedia already. The owner may want her as an Ascended Master (README §18.4 archive rules: books such as The Possible Human and Jump Time, and the Jean Houston Foundation); that's a separate decision, not part of this sprint.
